header: This holds the rules behind the employee form (step 66e): what the form holds, how a typed department code and a chosen designation become ids, what changes between the saved record and the form, and WHICH SECTION IS OPEN. It is PURE: no React, no drawing. I keep the look of the form in EmployeeAdminUi.tsx; the requests and the state are in EmployeeAdminPanel.tsx.

symbols.name: unlockedSections
symbols.sig: export function unlockedSections(v: FormValues, lookups: Lookups, errors: FieldErrors, o: { mode: "add" | "modify"; datesVisible: boolean; loaded: boolean }): Unlocked
doc: The order of the form (my words, 1 Nov 2026: "from top to bottom the sections get activated when the upper section is filled completely with all the constraints"). PURE. Identity always open. Posting opens when the Identity is complete (a ticket of 6 digits not starting with 0, the SAIL P.No. for a new employee, the name) and has no error. Dates open when Posting is complete: a designation code, a department code that fits the ticket. Contact opens when the dates are complete: both dates, valid (for anybody but the HOD there are no dates to fill, so Contact opens with Posting). `errors` holds ALL the errors of the record as it stands, not only those already shown.

doc: Here I compare the record the person opened against the record as it is now, field by field, to show what the OTHER person changed; the person sees only what he may see (no dates for an executive, contact only as masked).

symbols.name: rebaseForm
symbols.sig: export function rebaseForm(base: FormValues, mine: FormValues, theirs: FormValues): { values: FormValues; kept: Array<keyof FormValues>; overlaps: Array<keyof FormValues> }
symbols.returns: { values: FormValues; kept: Array<keyof FormValues>; overlaps: Array<keyof FormValues> }
doc: The three-way merge. `base` is the form as it was when the person opened the record, `mine` what is in the form now, `theirs` the form of the record as it is now. A field the person CHANGED (mine is not base) keeps his value; every other field takes THEIR value. I want his work never lost and, above all, I do not let him put back what the other person changed by saving a form that is out of date. `overlaps` are the fields BOTH changed to different values: his value is kept, and he is told to look at them. The ticket is never his to change.

behaviours: an empty form: everything below the Identity is locked
the Identity needs ALL THREE: the ticket, the SAIL P.No. and the name (one missing keeps Posting locked)
...and they must be RIGHT: a ticket starting with 0, a short ticket, a P.No. with a space keep Posting locked
with the Identity complete, Posting is open and the dates are STILL locked
Posting needs a designation code AND a department code that exists
...and they must fit the ticket: an executive cannot take a non-executive designation, nor a department of the non-executives
with Posting complete the dates are open and Contact is STILL locked
the dates need BOTH, and valid: one missing, a future date, a joining before 23 for a direct recruit keep Contact locked
with the dates complete, Contact is open: all four sections are open
a section does not stay open if what is above it is broken again: clearing the name locks everything below
for anybody but the HOD there are no dates to fill: Contact opens as soon as Posting is complete
changing a person: the SAIL P.No. is not needed to open Posting (an old record may have none); the rest is the same
nothing is open before the codes have been loaded
before the codes load: 'Loading…'
an empty form says what is wrong with the TICKET first
with the Identity right it asks for the designation, then the department
with Posting right and the dates empty it says to fill in BOTH DATES (not the mobile that is not open yet)
a wrong date is named before anything of the contact
with the dates right, an executive is NOT asked for the CUG mobile (it is optional, added later): nothing stands in the way of the review
...a wrong NIC mail is named before the missing mobile (form order: the mails are above the mobile)
a complete record has no reason; a change with nothing changed says so
a delegate (no dates) with Posting done is not asked for dates
theirChanges: nothing differs, nothing listed
theirChanges lists what the other person changed, field by field, with the old and the new (an empty value is a dash)
...the dates only for somebody who may see them
...a changed contact detail is listed as the masks show it (an executive: the two mails; anybody else: the one e-mail)
rebase: the person changed the ADDRESS, the other the DESIGNATION: both are in the result (his address on top of their designation)
rebase: what the person did NOT touch always takes THEIR value, so he cannot put back what they changed by saving a form that is out of date
rebase: a field BOTH changed to different values keeps the person's value and is reported as an overlap
rebase: both changed a field to the SAME value is not an overlap
rebase: the person changed nothing: the result is exactly their version
rebase: what the person TYPED in the contact fields (they start empty) is kept; the ticket is never his
rebase: the doctor switch is merged like any field
every field of the form has a label for the words said to the person
